thread:
incident-bot: SEV2 page — repeated GPU driver resets detected on cluster-03. Alert payload: multiple NVidia Xid events and ECC counts spiking. Paging oncall.

sylvia: paging oncall — seeing driver resets and container crashes on gpu-node-14. Noticing higher 503 rate on inference routes.

mike: on it, pulling node logs now. running nvidia-smi and dmesg.

jen: any customer impact yet? eva-cs pinged.

eva-cs: Flowlytics reporting elevated latency and intermittent 503s on /v1/predict, ~10-15 fail/minute. They opened an incident with us.

mike: quick nvidia-smi snapshot shows ECC volatile errors + Xid 43:

```# nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,PROCESS
==============GPU 0===============
Ecc Errors
  Volatile
    Single Bit ECC Errors                        : 42
    Double Bit ECC Errors                        : 1
    Pending Volatile Errors                      : 3

Processes
  GPU PID : 12345   C  /usr/bin/python -m inference

NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 43, GPU has fallen off the bus
```

alex: pods using GPU0 are crashlooping with exit code 137 (OOM/killed) and then driver reset.

nate: that Xid code usually points at memory/PCIe issues or a HW fault; could be ECC-related memory corruption.

mike: dmesg shows repeated NVRM messages and a host reset event:

```[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 43
[ 1234.568123] NVRM: GPU at 00000000:3b:00.0 has fallen off the bus.
[ 1234.568456] NVRM: GPU reset succeeded, but processes killed.
```

infra-bot: Recommended immediate mitigations: cordon gpu-node-14, drain workloads, blacklist GPU device in scheduler until hardware triage.

sylvia: Agreed. mike, verify spare capacity and start draining. jen, eva-cs — coordinate customer failover.

mike: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-14` -> node cordoned.

mike: starting drain: `kubectl drain gpu-node-14 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

mike: most pods evicted successfully, two remain stuck due to local PVC and nodeAffinity.

jen: stuck pods are stateful scratch caches pinned to local SSD. Those need manual intervention to reschedule.

alex: risky to migrate stateful scratch mid-incident. Recommend failing over traffic to fallback model route instead.

sylvia: eva-cs, flip traffic to fallback route for affected customers. We'll keep node cordoned and pull hardware ticket.

eva-cs: Done — Flowlytics switched to fallback-model (quantized small-llm) at the ingress layer. They report errors drop to near-0 and latency stabilized.

nate: For hardware: recommend power-cycle GPU, run ECC/memtest and thermal checks. Also collect nv-host-reset logs and sysfs dumps.

mike: collecting logs and diag outputs. uploaded /var/log/nvidia and dmesg dump to incident ticket.

infra-bot: Suggested short-term scheduler change: blacklist GPU index 0 on gpu-node-14 to allow GPUs 1..N if present, otherwise keep node drained.

sylvia: Ops decision: keep node cordoned, hardware verification first, do not return to production until driver+hardware validated. Initiate hardware replacement if memtest fails.

mike: opened hardware escalation with colo: Ticket HW-9421. Requesting on-site tech to reseat GPU and run vendor diagnostics.

jen: Post-incident action: run canary of latest driver on single spare node with stress test and our inference fleet load profile.

sylvia: I'll coordinate change window for that. Also need to confirm whether recent model rollout (small-llm-optim) touched CUDA kernels — possible regression vector.

mike: saving affected model containers and KV-cache snapshots for replays. Attaching pod manifests and crash logs to INC-2387.

eva-cs: Notifying affected customers in status page and one-off messages. No evidence of data exfiltration.

sylvia: Summary of immediate actions: cordon & drain node, failover customer traffic to fallback route, open hardware ticket, keep incident SEV2 until hardware verification, prepare driver-canary test.

infra-bot: Incident ticket INC-2387 created and linked. Timeline note: mitigation completed; monitoring for recurrences.

sylvia: Handoff: oncall nate will own hardware verification and maintenance follow-up. I'll lead postmortem and customer comms. jen will write the postmortem.

nate: ack — taking ownership for hardware triage and test results. Will report back with memtest & vendor diag.

incident-bot: Channel will be archived in 2h if no new updates. Please update INC-2387 with hardware test results and driver version used for validation.
